SELECT COUNT(*) AS japanese_entries,
       COUNT(DISTINCT setCode) AS set_codes,
       COUNT(translation) AS populated_names,
       SUM(TRIM(translation) = '') AS empty_names,
       MIN(translation) AS first_name,
       MAX(translation) AS last_name
FROM main.set_translations
WHERE language = 'Japanese'

arguments.sql:
WITH japanese_names AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT setCode
    FROM main.set_translations
    WHERE language = 'Japanese'
      AND TRIM(translation) <> ''
)
SELECT s.type AS expansion_type,
       COUNT(j.setCode) AS sets_with_japanese_name
FROM main.sets AS s
LEFT JOIN japanese_names AS j ON j.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type ASC
